# Settings

**Reference.** The environment variables that configure Outprint, with type, default and effect.

Every setting is an environment variable. The heading above it names the part
that reads it. The PDF action settings go to the Gateway; the injector reads
them too. A setting that is **required** has no usable default: the service
does not start without it. All others work unset.

Some settings override a key of the [service configuration](service-configuration.md),
and the [limits](limits.md) page lists what the size and time limits mean.

## Gateway

### `OUTLINE_URL`

**Type:** `URL`. **Required:** yes. **Default:** none.

The base URL of Outline, as the Gateway reaches it. The Gateway does not start without it.

### `OUTPRINT_WORKER_URL`

**Type:** `URL`. **Required:** yes. **Default:** none.

The base URL of the Worker. The Gateway does not start without it. The Compose file sets it.

### `OUTLINE_PUBLIC_URL`

**Type:** `URL`. **Required:** no. **Default:** none.

The URL Outline names itself, when `OUTLINE_URL` is an internal address. The Gateway uses it to recognise the images of a document.

### `OUTPRINT_ADMISSION_SLOTS`

**Type:** `integer`. **Required:** no. **Default:** `1`.

How many PDFs are made at once. At least 1. Overrides `slots` in the service configuration.

### `OUTPRINT_ADMISSION_QUEUE_DEPTH`

**Type:** `integer`. **Required:** no. **Default:** `4`.

How many requests wait for a free slot. 0 or more. Overrides `queueDepth` in the service configuration.

### `OUTPRINT_ADMISSION_PER_USER`

**Type:** `integer`. **Required:** no. **Default:** `1`.

How many PDFs one user may have queued and running together. At least 1. Overrides `perUser` in the service configuration.

### `OUTPRINT_ADMISSION_MAX_WAIT`

**Type:** `duration`. **Required:** no. **Default:** `60s`.

How long a queued request waits for a slot, for example `30s`. Longer than zero. Overrides `maxWait` in the service configuration.

## Worker

### `OUTPRINT_MAX_PAGES`

**Type:** `integer`. **Required:** no. **Default:** `500`.

The most pages a PDF may have. A positive integer. A malformed value stops the Worker.

### `OUTPRINT_MAX_PDF_BYTES`

**Type:** `integer` (bytes). **Required:** no. **Default:** `52428800`.

The largest PDF the Worker returns, in bytes: 50 MiB. From 1 up to that value; it can be lowered but not raised.

## Gateway and Worker

### `OUTPRINT_LISTEN`

**Type:** `address`. **Required:** no. **Default:** `:8080` (Gateway), `:8081` (Worker).

The address to listen on, for example `:9000`.

### `OUTPRINT_WORKER_TOKEN`

**Type:** `string` (a secret). **Required:** no. **Default:** none.

A shared token. When set on the Worker, it only accepts requests that carry it, so the Gateway needs the same value. Empty means no token.

### `OUTPRINT_TIMEOUT`

**Type:** `duration`. **Required:** no. **Default:** `60s`.

The time one PDF may take, for example `90s`. A value that is not a positive duration is ignored.

### `OUTPRINT_LOG_LEVEL`

**Type:** one of `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`. **Required:** no. **Default:** `info`.

How much is logged. An unknown value is ignored. The command line logs at `warn` unless set.

### `OUTPRINT_SERVICE_CONFIG`

**Type:** `path`. **Required:** no. **Default:** none.

The service configuration file. The image sets `/opt/outprint/service.yaml`. Without it, a service needs `--service-config`.

### `OUTPRINT_TEMPLATES_ROOT`

**Type:** `path`. **Required:** no. **Default:** none.

The folder with the Template packages. Wins over `templatesRoot` in the service configuration. The image sets `/opt/outprint/templates`.

### `OUTPRINT_CONFIGURATIONS_ROOT`

**Type:** `path`. **Required:** no. **Default:** none.

The folder with the Configuration packages. Wins over `configurationsRoot` in the service configuration. The image sets `/opt/outprint/configurations`.

## PDF action

### `OUTPRINT_BUTTON_PLACEMENT`

**Type:** one of `menu`, `button`. **Required:** no. **Default:** `menu`.

Where the PDF action sits. `menu` puts it in the Export submenu of the document menu, `button` in a header button before Share.

### `OUTPRINT_BUTTON_LABELS`

**Type:** `JSON object`. **Required:** no. **Default:** the built-in texts.

Replaces the texts of the action. Keys are `menu`, `button` and `tooltip`, each a map from a language such as `de` to a text of 1 to 80 characters.

## Injector

### `OUTPRINT_INJECTOR_UPSTREAM`

**Type:** `URL`. **Required:** yes. **Default:** none.

The base URL of Outline. The only place the injector sends requests to, besides the Gateway. The injector does not start without it.

### `OUTPRINT_INJECTOR_GATEWAY_URL`

**Type:** `URL`. **Required:** no. **Default:** none.

The base URL of the Gateway. When set, requests below the Gateway prefix go there. Empty leaves the routing to an edge proxy.

### `OUTPRINT_INJECTOR_LISTEN`

**Type:** `address`. **Required:** no. **Default:** `:8090`.

The address the injector listens on.

### `OUTPRINT_INJECTOR_CSP_ALLOW_SELF`

**Type:** `boolean`. **Required:** no. **Default:** `false`.

Adds `'self'` to the script policy of Outline, so the page may load the script from the injector's origin.

### `OUTPRINT_INJECTOR_LOG_LEVEL`

**Type:** one of `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`. **Required:** no. **Default:** `info`.

How much the injector logs. An unknown value is ignored.
